# TaxAudit

> TaxAudit provides comprehensive IRS tax debt relief, audit defense, and representation services to help individuals and businesses resolve tax issues with the IRS.

TaxAudit specializes in tax audit defense and IRS representation, offering expert guidance on debt relief programs, payment plans, liens, levies, and wage garnishment removal. The platform connects clients with licensed tax professionals for personalized consultation and representation before the IRS.

## Key Topics

- IRS Debt Relief
- Tax Audit Defense
- Offer in Compromise
- Installment Agreement
- Wage Garnishment
- Tax Lien Release
- Tax Levy Relief
- Innocent Spouse Relief
- Audit Reconsideration
- Currently Not Collectible Status
- Revenue Officer Representation
- Penalty Abatement
- IRS Representation
- Payment Plans
- Back Taxes

## Tax Debt Relief Solutions

- [Offer in Compromise Assistance | Expert IRS Tax Debt Relief](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/offer-in-compromise): Guide to settling tax debt for less via IRS Offer in Compromise program
- [IRS Installment Agreement | Get on a Tax Debt Payment Plan](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/installment-agreement): Details on IRS installment agreements and payment plan options for tax debt
- [Stop IRS Wage Garnishment | Expert Help Removing Garnishment](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/stop-wage-garnishment): Guide to stopping and removing IRS wage garnishment for back taxes owed
- [Tax Levy Relief | Expert Help to Stop and / or Remove a Tax Levy](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/tax-levy-relief): Information on stopping and removing IRS asset levies for tax debt
- [Tax Lien Relief | Help with Release an IRS of State Tax Lien](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/tax-lien-release): Guide to releasing federal and state tax liens on property
- [IRS Audit Reconsideration of Tax Debt | See If You Qualify](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/audit-reconsideration): Guide to IRS audit reconsideration process and qualification requirements
- [IRS Innocent Spouse Relief Provision - Spouse Has Tax Debt](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/innocent-spouse-relief): Guide to three types of IRS innocent spouse relief provisions for joint returns
- [IRS Economic Hardship and Currently Not Collectible Status](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/currently-not-collectible): Explanation of IRS economic hardship status and collection suspension options
- [IRS First Time Penalty Abatement | Tax Penalty Removal Help](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/penalty-abatement): Information on IRS penalty removal through first-time abatement and reasonable cause
- [Help with Large Amounts of Tax Debt | IRS Representation](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/solutions/revenue-officer-case-representation): Representation services for large tax debt cases assigned to IRS Revenue Officers
- [IRS Debt Relief: Stop the IRS Collections Process](https://www.taxaudit.com/tax-debt-relief/irs-debt-relief): Overview of IRS debt relief options to delay and resolve collections process
